description: Configure voice channels that display live server statistics

params.name: userCount
params.description: Total count of users on your server

params.name: memberCount
params.description: Total count of members (not bots) on your server

params.name: onlineUserCount
params.description: Total count of online (dnd or online status) users on your server

params.name: channelCount
params.description: Total count of channels on your server

params.name: roleCount
params.description: Total count of roles on your server

params.name: botCount
params.description: Count of Bots on your server

params.name: dndCount
params.description: Count of members (not bots) with DND as status

params.name: onlineMemberCount
params.description: Count of members (not bots) with online (and only online) as status

params.name: awayCount
params.description: Count of members (not bots) with away status

params.name: offlineCount
params.description: Count of members (not bots) with offline status

params.name: guildBoosts
params.description: Show how often this guild was boosted

params.name: boostLevel
params.description: Shows the current boost-level of this guild

params.name: boosterCount
params.description: Count of boosters on this guild

params.name: emojiCount
params.description: Count of emojis on this guild

params.name: userWithRoleCount-<ID>
params.description: Count of members with a specific role (replace "<ID>" with an actual role-id)

params.name: onlineUserWithRoleCount-<ID>
params.description: Count of members with a specific role who are online (replace "<ID>" with an actual role-id)

content.name: updateInterval
content.description: You can set an interval here in which the bot should update the channels. Must be higher than seven; in minutes.
